# RECORD OF ADVICE – POLICY AMENDMENT
## Personal Lines Motor Insurance

---

**Financial Services Provider (FSP):**
• FSP Name: [INSERT FSP NAME]
• FSP License Number: [INSERT FSP LICENSE]
• Registered Address: [INSERT ADDRESS]
• Contact Number: [INSERT NUMBER]
• Email: [INSERT EMAIL]

**Authorised Representative:**
• Representative Name: [INSERT NAME]
• Representative Code: [INSERT CODE]
• Qualification: [INSERT RELEVANT QUALIFICATION – e.g., NQF Level 4 Short-Term Insurance]
• Date of Advice: [INSERT DATE]
• Contact Number: [INSERT NUMBER]

---

## 2. CLIENT IDENTIFICATION, KYC, FICA AND POPIA CONFIRMATION

**Client Details:**
• Full Legal Name: [INSERT CLIENT NAME]
• ID Number/Passport: [INSERT NUMBER]
• Date of Birth: [INSERT DOB]
• Residential Address: [INSERT ADDRESS]
• Contact Number: [INSERT NUMBER]
• Email Address: [INSERT EMAIL]

**KYC/FICA Verification Status:**
• FICA verification completed: Yes / No [SELECT]
• ID document sighted and verified: [DATE]
• Proof of residence obtained: [DATE AND DOCUMENT TYPE]
• Source of funds verified: [YES/NO – DATE]
• PEP status confirmed: [NO / YES – DETAILS IF APPLICABLE]

**POPIA Compliance:**

• Consent to process personal data obtained: Yes
• Data retention period advised: Yes
• Right to access and correction explained: Yes
• Direct marketing consent obtained: Yes / No [SELECT]

---

**END OF SECTIONS 1 AND 2**

---

# RECORD OF ADVICE – POLICY AMENDMENT (CONTINUED)
## Personal Lines Motor Insurance – Vehicle Addition

---

## 3. NEEDS ANALYSIS

**Motor Insurance – Vehicle Addition**

The client has requested the addition of a new motor vehicle to the existing personal lines policy: 2023 Toyota Corolla, market value R320,000. The vehicle is intended for [INSERT INTENDED USE – personal/business/mixed use]. Based on discussion with the client, the identified need is to extend comprehensive motor cover to this additional asset, ensuring continuity of protection consistent with the existing policy structure and the client's stated risk profile. The vehicle's market value, age, and intended use have been confirmed and documented. The client requires cover for accidental damage, theft, third-party liability, and legal liability exposure arising from operation of this motor vehicle. No change to the client's overall risk profile or insurance requirements has been identified beyond the addition of this single asset to the existing arrangement.

---

## 4. MARKET COMPARISON

Market Comparison – Not applicable – this is a policy amendment and no new market comparison was required or conducted. The client's instruction is to add a vehicle to the existing in-force policy with the current insurer. No re-quotation or competitive market review has been undertaken or provided.

---

**END OF SECTIONS 3 AND 4**

---

# RECORD OF ADVICE – POLICY AMENDMENT (CONTINUED)
## Personal Lines Motor Insurance – Vehicle Addition

---

## 5. PRODUCT RECOMMENDED

**Insurer:** [Current Insurer – as per existing POL-2024-882]

**Amendment Details:**

• Addition of 1 × motor vehicle to existing personal lines comprehensive motor policy
• Vehicle: 2023 Toyota Corolla
• Sum Insured (Agreed Value): R320,000
• Cover Type: Comprehensive motor insurance
• Effective Date: [INSERT DATE]

**Section 9(1) Statutory Disclosure:**

**Benefits:**
• Accidental damage cover (collision, impact, overturning)
• Theft and attempted theft cover
• Third-party liability cover (legal liability for bodily injury and property damage to third parties)
• Legal liability cover (statutory legal liability arising from operation of the motor vehicle)
• Windscreen and glass cover (where applicable to policy terms)
• Breakdown/roadside assistance (where applicable)

**Key Exclusions:**
• Wear and tear; mechanical or electrical breakdown
• Driving under the influence of alcohol or drugs
• Use of vehicle for hire or reward (unless declared and endorsed)
• Damage arising from racing, speed testing, or competitive events
• Claims arising from use of vehicle by driver under minimum legal driving age
• Uninsured losses; damage to accessories not affixed to the vehicle
• Claims excluded under the standard policy wording applicable to the existing policy

**Excess Structure:**
• Standard Compulsory Excess: [INSERT AMOUNT as per policy schedule]
• Voluntary Excess (optional): [INSERT AMOUNT if client has elected]
• Windscreen Excess: [INSERT AMOUNT or state "No excess"]
• Accident Excess (if applicable): [INSERT AMOUNT]

**SASRIA Cover:**
• Cover extends to loss or damage caused by civil unrest, riot, public disturbance, strike, lockout, malicious acts, and terrorism as defined in the Terrorism Act 33 of 2004, subject to the standard SASRIA excess of R7,500 or as declared on the policy schedule.

**Premium:**
• Monthly contribution for vehicle addition: R[INSERT AMOUNT]
• Total amended monthly premium: R[INSERT TOTAL]
• Payment method: [direct debit/EFT/other as per existing arrangement]

**Policy Conditions:**
• Vehicle must comply with all applicable road traffic legislation
• Client must notify insurer of any material change in use, ownership, or circumstances
• Vehicle must be maintained in roadworthy condition
• All driving must be conducted in compliance with the National Road Traffic Act 93 of 1996

---

## 6. REMUNERATION AND CONFLICT OF INTEREST DECLARATION

**FSP Details:**
• FSP Name: [INSERT FIRM NAME]
• FSP Registration Number: [INSERT FAIS REGISTRATION NUMBER]
• Representative: [INSERT REPRESENTATIVE NAME AND FAIS NUMBER]

**Remuneration Structure:**

The representative is remunerated on a commission basis as follows:

• Commission on policy amendment (vehicle addition): [INSERT PERCENTAGE]% of the monthly premium, payable by the insurer
• This represents a once-off commission payment at inception of the amendment
• Renewal commission (annually): [INSERT PERCENTAGE]% of the annual premium for this vehicle addition, payable by the insurer in subsequent years
• The commission structure does not vary based on the insurer's choice or product specification

**Conflict of Interest Declaration:**

• The representative and/or FSP holds a financial interest in the placement of this amendment with the current insurer, as commission is payable upon acceptance
• The representative is employed by the FSP and is remunerated partly on commission from insurance placements
• No alternative insurer commission structure has been presented as a material inducement to recommend a different insurer
• The recommendation to add the vehicle to the existing policy with the current insurer is based on client continuity, existing relationship, and alignment with the client's stated instruction, NOT on commission differential
• The client has not requested a competitive market quotation; the client has requested amendment to the existing policy
• No remuneration is payable to the FSP or representative if the client declines this amendment
• The client is entitled to request a market comparison at any time; none has been requested for this amendment

**Disclosure:**
The client acknowledges that remuneration is earned by the representative/FSP and that this creates a potential conflict of interest. This conflict does not materially affect the suitability of the recommendation given the client's explicit instruction to add the vehicle to the existing policy and the absence of any competing product recommendation.

---

## 7. REPLACEMENT ADVICE

**Not Applicable.**

This is a policy amendment (addition of a vehicle) to an existing in-force personal lines motor policy. No existing insurance product is being replaced, cancelled, or superseded. The client's existing cover for other vehicles remains unchanged. No replacement advice under Board Notice 80 of 2003 is required.

---

## 8. CLIENT ACCEPTANCE RECORD

**Client Confirmation:**

I/We, [CLIENT NAME(S)], having read and understood this Record of Advice and the Section 9(1) statutory disclosure provided above, confirm as follows:

• I/We have read and understood the benefits, exclusions, excess structure, and conditions of the recommended product
• I/We confirm that the needs analysis reflects my/our insurance requirements
• I/We confirm that the information provided in the KYC/FICA documentation is accurate and complete
• I/We understand the remuneration structure and acknowledge the potential conflict of interest
• I/We accept the recommendation to add the 2023 Toyota Corolla (value R320,000) to the existing personal lines motor policy under policy number POL-2024-882
• I/We understand that comprehensive cover includes accidental damage, theft, third-party liability, and legal liability as outlined above
• I/We have had the opportunity to ask questions and have received satisfactory answers
• I/We accept the proposed monthly contribution of R[INSERT AMOUNT] for this vehicle addition
• I/We understand and accept the excess structure as set out above
• I/We acknowledge that the policy does not cover wear and tear, mechanical breakdown, or claims arising from driving under the influence
• I/We understand that SASRIA cover is included and subject to a minimum excess of R7,500
• I/We have been given a copy of this Record of Advice and all relevant policy documentation

**Client Signature/Electronic Acceptance:**

Client Name (Print): ________________________________________________

Signature/E-signature: ________________________________________________

Date: ________________________________________________

Witness/Representative Name (Print): ________________________________________________

Witness/Representative Signature: ________________________________________________

Date: ________________________________________________

---

**FSP/Representative Declaration:**

I, [REPRESENTATIVE NAME], Representative of [FSP NAME], FAIS Registration Number [NUMBER], confirm that:

• This Record of Advice has been completed in accordance with the FAIS Act 37 of 2002 and Board Notice 80 of 2003
• The needs analysis reflects the client's stated requirements and risk profile
• The recommendation is suitable for the client's circumstances
• All required statutory disclosures under Section 9(1) have been made
• The client has been afforded the opportunity to ask questions
• The client's acceptance has been obtained prior to implementation
• This advice is valid as at the date of signature below

Representative Name (Print): ________________________________________________

Signature: ________________________________________________

Date: ________________________________________________

FSP Name: ________________________________________________

FSP Stamp/Official Seal: ________________________________________________

---

**RECORD RETENTION:**

This Record of Advice must be retained on file for a minimum of five years from the date of the client's acceptance and must be produced to the FSCA on request. A copy has been provided to the client.

---

*This Record of Advice has been prepared by Riya, a FAIS-compliant advisory assistant, and should be reviewed and countersigned by a responsible representative or compliance officer of the FSP before dispatch to the client. The FSP remains accountable for all advice rendered and all statutory compliance obligations under the FAIS Act 37 of 2002 and the General Code of Conduct in Board Notice 80 of 2003.*
